messages:
devon: Heads up — customer S-7421 opened a ticket: p99 latency jumps from ~420ms -> ~3.2s after the nebulax-extended rollout. Affects long-context (>=16k). sample req id: req=neb-9f3a.

maria: Looking. Can you paste a repro request and the full req id?

devon: Pasting a minimal repro (they're hitting hosted API, us-west1, token auth):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{\"model\":\"nebulax-extended\",\"input\":\"<LONG_SEQ_18k>\",\"max_tokens\":256}'
```

raj: Are we seeing auth refresh timeouts or billing 429s in the logs?

sre-bot: Logs for req=neb-9f3a (snip):
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] ingress: auth: token_lookup latency=12ms
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] auth: token_refresh status=504 latency=1532ms
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] runtime: tokenizer=nebulax-v3 variant=longctx_kv enabled=true kvcache_miss=true
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] runtime: model_exec latency=1848ms
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] proxy: billing_check status=429 attempts=1 backoff=500ms
```

zoe: From support ticket: billing proxy returned 429 for entitlement check immediately before the spike. Their traffic hit a peak window and our per-request billing sync amplified the tail.

maria: TL;DR: two compounding issues — (1) nebulax tokenizer change increased KV cache misses on long sequences, raising model_exec time, (2) entitlement/billing sync + auth refresh path occasionally falls back to remote idp causing ~1.5s extra tail on auth. Together they push p99 over SLA.

maria: Short-term mitigations: (A) pin customer to nebulax-extended@v2 (old tokenizer) via support override, (B) enable auth-token caching in ingress (hotfix PR #4456), (C) flip feature flag to disable per-request billing-sync for high-throughput tenants. I'm deploying auth-cache to staging now.

devon: What's the support override command and ETA for rollback?

maria: Support override (API): `PATCH /v1/customers/S-7421/overrides` body `{"model_pin":"nebulax-extended@v2"}`. Staging rollback in ~12m, prod rollback in ~30m after smoke. Auth-cache hotfix merged; deploy to prod in ~6m.

raj: Long-term: add a perf job repro/nebulax-longctx-auth in our perf infra, add an alert for the combined signal (kvcache_miss && auth_refresh_errors) on p95/p99, and add a hard check to model-onboarding: tokenizer longctx KV hitrate >= 90% before GA.

zoe: Customer notified: "We've identified the cause and are pinning you to the previous tokenizer while we roll a fix. Expect updates ~45min." :thumbsup:

devon: Thanks — keep posting updates here. I'll attach logs and ticket numbers to the support case.
